3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: operations O1–O16
5	
6	The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §60–§75. Each
7	operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
8	an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
9	relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
10	`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
14	
15	/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
16	effects of §72 and §73). -/
17	def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
18	  | _, [] => []
19	  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l
20	
21	/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/
22	
23	/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
24	identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
25	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
26	  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩
27	
28	/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
29	structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
30	  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
31	  active : s.Active src
32	  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
33	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
34	  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
35	  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
36	  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
37	  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
38	  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
39	  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
40	  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
41	  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
42	  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
43	    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
44	    True
45	  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
46	  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F
47	
48	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
49	instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
50	    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
51	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧
52	    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
53	    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
54	    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
55	      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
56	      True) ∧
57	    s.top ∈ s.F)
58	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
59	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩
60	
61	/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
62	def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
63	  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)
64	
65	/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/
66	
67	/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
68	per region, held by the current frame. -/
69	def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
70	  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }
71	
72	/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
73	descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
74	def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
75	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
76	    False
77	
78	/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
79	instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
80	  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance
81	
82	/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
83	structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
84	  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
85	  active : s.Active src
86	  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
87	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
88	  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
89	  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
90	  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
91	  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
92	  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
93	  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
94	  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
95	  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p
96	
97	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
98	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
99	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
100	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
101	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
102	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
103	    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
104	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
105	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
106	
107	/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
108	def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
109	  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)
110	
111	/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/
112	
113	/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
114	the anchors of its holding place. -/
115	def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
116	  | some x => { s with
117	      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
118	      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
119	  | none => s
120	
121	/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
122	the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
123	def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
124	  | .frame f => f = s.top
125	  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p
126	
127	/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
128	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
129	  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance
130	
131	/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
132	structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
133	  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
134	  active : s.Active a
135	  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
136	  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
137	  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
138	  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
139	  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
140	  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
141	  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
142	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
143	    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)
144	
145	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
146	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
147	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
148	    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
149	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
150	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
151	      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
152	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
153	
154	/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
155	def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
156	  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)
157	
158	/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/
159	
160	/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
161	def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
162	  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)
163	
164	/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
165	def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
166	  | [] => 0
167	  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1
168	
169	/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
170	position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
171	def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
172	  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
173	  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
174	      match parentOf P r with
175	      | some p => if p < r then
176	          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
177	      | none => none
178	
179	/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
180	def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r
181	
182	/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
183	with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
184	def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
185	  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
186	    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
187	  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
188	    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z
189	
190	/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
191	instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
192	  unfold SameShape; infer_instance
193	
194	/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
195	def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
196	  | .place r => partOf P r q
197	  | .frame _ => False
198	
199	/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
200	instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
201	  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance
202	
203	/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
204	`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
205	def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
206	  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
207	  | .frame f => .frame f
208	
209	/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
210	part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
211	def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
212	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
213	    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D
214	
215	/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
216	destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
217	to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
218	def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
219	  { s with
220	    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
221	      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
222	    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
223	      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
224	    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
225	    A := s.A.map fun y =>
226	      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }
227	
228	/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
229	def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
230	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
231	    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False
232	
233	/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
234	instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
235	  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance
236	
237	/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
238	transitively. -/
239	def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
240	  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
241	  | .frame _ => False
242	
243	/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
244	instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
245	  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance
246	
247	/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
248	def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
249	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False
250	
251	/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
252	instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
253	  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance
254	
255	/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
256	parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
257	def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
258	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
259	    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D
260	
261	/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
262	def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
263	  | .place p => footprint s.P p
264	  | .frame _ => []
265	
266	/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
267	def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
268	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False
269	
270	/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
271	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance
272	
273	/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
274	in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
275	def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
276	  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
277	    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j
278	
279	/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
280	instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
281	  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance
282	
283	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
284	structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
285	  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
286	  srcUsable : s.Usable src
287	  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
288	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
289	  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
290	  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
291	  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
292	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
293	  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
294	  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
295	  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
296	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
297	  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
298	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
299	  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
300	  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
301	  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source. -/
302	  noOutsideDerived : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j
303	  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
304	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
305	  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
306	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
307	  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
308	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
309	  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
310	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
311	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
312	      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
313	        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
314	  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
315	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
316	
317	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
318	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
319	    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
320	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
321	    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
322	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
323	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
324	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
325	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
326	    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
327	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
328	        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
329	          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
330	    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst)
331	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩,
332	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o⟩⟩
333	
334	/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
335	def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
336	  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

338	/-! ## O5 `depend` (§64) -/
339	
340	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (§64, `ok` effect): `anchor` is added to `D(result)`. -/
341	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
342	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
343	
344	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (§64). The "real dependency" part of §64.2 is not represented;
345	§64.4 holds by construction (`depsOf`). -/
346	structure DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop where
347	  /-- §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
348	  usable : s.Usable q
349	  /-- §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
350	  right : HasRight s .modify q
351	  /-- §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
352	  anchorActive : s.Active x
353	  /-- §64.3: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an ancestor. -/
354	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
355	
356	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` (§64). -/
357	instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) :=
358	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable q ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧ s.Active x ∧ EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q))
359	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
360	
361	/-- `depend` as a relation (§64). -/
362	def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
363	  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

365	/-! ## O8 `store` (§65) -/
366	
367	/-- Effect of `store(authority, target)` (§65, `ok` effect): `target` becomes the holder, the
368	authority joins `D(target)`, and only leaf `target` becomes `Init`. -/
369	def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
370	  | some y => { s with
371	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
372	      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
373	      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
374	  | none => s
375	
376	/-- Preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
377	structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
378	  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
379	  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
380	    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
381	  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
382	  usable : s.Usable p
383	  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
384	  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
385	  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
386	  right : HasRight s .modify p
387	  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
388	  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
389	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
390	  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
391	  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
392	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
393	  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
394	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
395	  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
396	  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
397	  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
398	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)
399	
400	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
401	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
402	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
403	      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
404	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
405	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
406	    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
407	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
408	    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
409	    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))
410	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
411	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩
412	
413	/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
414	def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
415	  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

417	/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/
418	
419	/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
420	allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
421	def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
422	  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)
423	
424	/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
425	otherwise. -/
426	def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
427	  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
428	  | some o => .place o
429	  | none => hd
430	
431	/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
432	kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
433	def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
434	    List Place :=
435	  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
436	    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩
437	
438	/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
439	§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
440	owning element of its parent. -/
441	def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
442	  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
443	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
444	      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
445	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True
446	
447	/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
448	instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
449	  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance
450	
451	/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
452	def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
453	  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone
454	
455	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/
456	
457	/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
458	def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape
459	
460	/-- Effect of `enterFrame(params, locals)` (§72, `ok` effect): a new frame `nF` is pushed; the
461	parameters are now held by it; locals are appended (uninitialized, no anchor, alive, unpinned)
462	with one active root `Modify` authority per root local, held by the new frame. -/
463	def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
464	  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
465	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
466	    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
467	      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
468	        ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
469	          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
470	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
471	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
472	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }
473	
474	/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
475	authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
476	def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
477	  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
478	    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True
479	
480	/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
481	instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
482	  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance
483	
484	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
485	not represented. -/
486	structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
487	  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
488	  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
489	  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
490	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
491	    y.origin ≠ none) False
492	  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
493	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
494	  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
495	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
496	  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
497	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)
498	
499	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
500	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
501	  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
502	      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
503	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
504	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
505	
506	/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
507	def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
508	  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)
509	
510	/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/
511	
512	/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
513	or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
514	def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
515	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False
516	
517	/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
518	instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
519	  unfold Survives; infer_instance
520	
521	/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
522	def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
523	  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)
524	
525	/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
526	derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
527	def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
528	  if Survives s F₀ a then
529	    match y.origin with
530	    | none => y
531	    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
532	  else { y with active := false }
533	
534	/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
535	not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
536	the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
537	def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
538	  { s with
539	    F := s.F.tail
540	    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
541	    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }
542	
543	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
544	structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
545	  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
546	  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
547	  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
548	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
549	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
550	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
551	  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
552	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
553	    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
554	  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
555	  dynamically. -/
556	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
557	    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
558	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
559	  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
560	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)
561	
562	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). -/
563	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) :=
564	  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
565	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
566	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
567	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
568	      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
569	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
570	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
571	    AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s))
572	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
573	
574	/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (§73). -/
575	def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)
576	
577	/-! ## O9 `read`, O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` (§66–§68) -/
578	
579	/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
580	def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
581	  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q
582	
583	/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
584	instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
585	  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance
586	
587	/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
588	contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
589	structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
590	  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
591	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
592	  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
593	  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
594	  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
595	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
596	  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
597	  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
598	  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
599	  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
600	
601	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
602	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
603	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
604	    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
605	    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
606	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
607	
608	/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
609	def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
610	  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s
611	
612	/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
613	storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
614	structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
615	  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
616	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
617	  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
618	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
619	  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
620	  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
621	  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
622	  over the written leaves. -/
623	  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
624	  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
625	  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
626	
627	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
628	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
629	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
630	    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
631	    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
632	    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
633	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
634	
635	/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
636	def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
637	  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }
638	
639	/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
640	def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
641	  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)
642	
643	/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
644	structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
645	  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
646	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
647	  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
648	  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
649	  /-- §68.2: `access` is exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`. -/
650	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
651	  /-- §68.2: `access` has a present effective mode on every leaf. -/
652	  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
653	  /-- §68.3: dependencies are valid. -/
654	  depsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
655	
656	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `writeShared` (§68). -/
657	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
658	    Decidable (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) :=
659	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l) ∧
660	    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
661	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
662	
663	/-- `writeShared` as a relation (§68). -/
664	def WriteSharedStep (k : K) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
665	  Guarded (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)
666	
667	/-! ## Release of authorities whose holder dies (§69, §70) -/
668	
669	/-- Releases every authority whose holder is no longer live (§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
670	def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
671	  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }
672	
673	/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/
674	
675	/-- `endUse p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§69, `ok` effect): the leaves of
676	`p` become `Uninit`; authorities held within `p` are released; anchors of `p` and its parts are
677	removed; storage owned by `p`, transitively, is marked dead. -/
678	def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
679	  { s with
680	    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
681	    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
682	    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (OwnedIn s.P p q)
683	    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }
684	
685	/-- Effect of `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died
686	are released. -/
687	def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)
688	
689	/-- Leaf whose use ends with the value at `p` (§69.2, §69.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that
690	stops being usable. -/
691	def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
692	  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)
693	
694	/-- Decidability of `EndingLeaf` (§69). -/
695	instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
696	  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance
697	
698	/-- Root authority of the value at `p` (§69.3): an authority with no origin covering a leaf of
699	`p`. -/
700	def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
701	  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint
702	
703	/-- Decidability of `IsRootOf` (§69.3). -/
704	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
705	  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance
706	
707	/-- Authority `j` does not block `endUse p` (§69.2): if it is an active derived authority over an
708	ending leaf, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
709	def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
710	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
711	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) →
712	      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True
713	
714	/-- Decidability of `EndUseAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
715	instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
716	  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
717	
718	/-- Anchor `x` survives `endUse p` (§69.3): not held within `p`, not a root of `p`, with a holder
719	that stays live. -/
720	def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
721	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
722	    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True
723	
724	/-- Decidability of `EndUseAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
725	instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
726	  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
727	
728	/-- Preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
729	structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
730	  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
731	  usable : s.Usable p
732	  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
733	  right : HasRight s .modify p
734	  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places. -/
735	  access : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j
736	  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
737	  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
738	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
739	    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
740	  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
741	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
742	
743	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
744	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
745	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
746	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
747	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
748	      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
749	    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
750	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
751	
752	/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
753	def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
754	  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

756	/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/
757	
758	/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
759	def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
760	  | .place _ => true
761	  | .frame _ => false
762	
763	/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
764	def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
765	  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False
766	
767	/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
768	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
769	  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance
770	
771	/-- Place `q` belongs to the unit released by `free p` (§70): a part of `p`, or storage owned by
772	`p`, transitively. -/
773	def FreedPlace (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := partOf P q p ∨ OwnedIn P p q
774	
775	/-- Decidability of `FreedPlace` (§70). -/
776	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (FreedPlace P p q) := by
777	  unfold FreedPlace; infer_instance
778	
779	/-- `free p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§70, `ok` effect): the released unit
780	is marked dead; authorities covering it, roots included, or held within `p` become inactive. -/
781	def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
782	  { s with
783	    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (FreedPlace s.P p q)
784	    A := s.A.map fun y =>
785	      if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
786	        { y with active := false } else y }
787	
788	/-- Effect of `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
789	released. -/
790	def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)
791	
792	/-- Leaf of the released unit (§70.3, §70.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that stops being
793	usable. -/
794	def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
795	  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)
796	
797	/-- Decidability of `FreedLeaf` (§70). -/
798	instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
799	  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance
800	
801	/-- Authority `j` does not block `free p` (§70.3): if it is an active derivative over the
802	footprint being freed, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
803	def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
804	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
805	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) →
806	      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

858	/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
859	structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
860	  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
861	  nonempty : ls ≠ []
862	  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
863	  element). -/
864	  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
865	  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
866	  parent. -/
867	  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
868	  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
869	  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
870	  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
871	  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
872	  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
873	    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
874	  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
875	  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
876	  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
877	  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner

879	/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
880	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
881	    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
882	  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
883	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
884	    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
885	      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
886	    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
887	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
888	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

890	/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
891	`owner`. -/
892	def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
893	  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

895	/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
896	`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, unpinned, with a root `Modify` authority with no
897	origin held by `owner`. -/
898	def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
899	  { s with
900	    P := allocP s owner ls
901	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
902	    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
903	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
904	        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
905	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
906	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
907	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }

910	precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
911	inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
912	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
913	  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
914	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
915	  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
916	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
917	  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

960	/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/
961	
962	/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
963	inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
964	  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
965	      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
966	  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
967	      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
968	  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
969	  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
970	  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
971	  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
972	      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
973	  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
974	  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
975	  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
976	  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
977	      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
978	  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
979	  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
980	  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
981	  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	`WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53), `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` (§57), the declared
7	statics and `S3.init` (§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics`
8	under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
9	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
10	-/
11	
12	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
13	
14	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
15	
16	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
17	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
18	
19	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
20	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
21	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
22	
23	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
24	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
25	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
26	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
27	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
28	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
29	
30	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
31	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
32	place. -/
33	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
34	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
35	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
36	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
37	
38	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
39	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
40	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
41	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
42	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
43	
44	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
45	
46	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
47	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
48	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
49	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
50	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
51	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
52	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
53	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
54	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
55	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
56	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
57	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
58	      f < s.nF) ∧
59	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
60	      o < s.P.length) ∧
61	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
62	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
63	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
64	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
65	  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
66	  root authority. -/
67	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
68	  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
69	  rootChain : RootChain s
70	  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
71	  rootHeld : RootHeld s
72	  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
73	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
74	    HolderLive s y.holder
75	
76	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
77	
78	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
79	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
80	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
81	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
82	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
83	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
84	
85	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
86	origin's and the derived footprint is within the origin's. -/
87	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
88	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
89	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint
90	
91	/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
92	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
93	
94	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
95	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
96	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls
97	
98	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
99	def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
100	
101	/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
102	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
103	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
104	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
105	
106	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
107	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
108	
109	/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/
110	
111	/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
112	place holding `b`. -/
113	def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
114	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
115	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
116	    | .frame _ => False) False
117	
118	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
119	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
120	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
121	  | _ => True
122	
123	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
124	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
125	whole place holding the next. -/
126	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
127	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
128	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
129	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
130	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)
131	
132	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
133	
134	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
135	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
136	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
137	
138	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
139	initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
140	owning static. -/
141	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
142	
143	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
144	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
145	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
146	
147	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
148	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
149	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead or
150	pinned. -/
151	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
152	  { F := [0]
153	    nF := 1
154	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
155	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
156	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
157	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
158	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
159	    D := fun _ => []
160	    dead := fun _ => false
161	    pin := fun _ => false }
162	
163	/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
164	directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
165	def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
166	  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
167	    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False
168	
169	/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/
170	
171	/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
172	inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
173	  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
174	  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'
175

808	/-- Decidability of `FreeAccessOK` (§70.3). -/
809	instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
810	  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
811	
812	/-- Anchor `x` survives `free p` (§70.3): it covers no leaf of the released unit, is not held
813	within `p`, and its holder stays live. -/
814	def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
815	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
816	    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True
817	
818	/-- Decidability of `FreeAnchorOK` (§70.3). -/
819	instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
820	  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
821	
822	/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (§70). -/
823	structure FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop where
824	  /-- §70.1: `place` is an `OwnedRoot`. -/
825	  ownedRoot : OwnedRoot s p
826	  /-- §70.2: `K.Deallocable(place)`. -/
827	  deallocable : k.Deallocable p
828	  /-- §70.2: `K.FreeCompat(place, auth)`. -/
829	  freeCompat : k.FreeCompat p auth
830	  /-- §70.3: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
831	  right : HasRight s .modify p
832	  /-- §70.3: no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside dying
833	  holders. -/
834	  access : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, FreeAccessOK s p j
835	  /-- §70.3: no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released unit or of its dead
836	  holders. -/
837	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x
838	  /-- §70.4: no leaf of the released unit is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
839	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
840	
841	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `free` (§70). -/
842	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
843	    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
844	    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) :=
845	  decidable_of_iff (OwnedRoot s p ∧ k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧
846	    HasRight s .modify p ∧ (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
847	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
848	    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
849	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
850	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩
851	
852	/-- `free` as a relation (§70). -/
853	def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
854	  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)
855	
856	/-! ## O14 `alloc` (§71) -/
857	
858	/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
859	structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
860	  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
861	  nonempty : ls ≠ []
862	  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
863	  element). -/
864	  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
865	  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
866	  parent. -/
867	  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
868	  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
869	  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
870	  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
871	  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
872	  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
873	    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
874	  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
875	  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
876	  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
877	  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner
878	
879	/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
880	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
881	    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
882	  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
883	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
884	    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
885	      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
886	    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
887	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
888	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩
889	
890	/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
891	`owner`. -/
892	def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
893	  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape
894	
895	/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
896	`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, unpinned, with a root `Modify` authority with no
897	origin held by `owner`. -/
898	def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
899	  { s with
900	    P := allocP s owner ls
901	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
902	    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
903	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
904	        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
905	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
906	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
907	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }
908	
909	/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
910	precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
911	inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
912	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
913	  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
914	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
915	  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
916	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
917	  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject
918	
919	/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/
920	
921	/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
922	structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
923	  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
924	  usable : s.Usable p
925	  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
926	  right : HasRight s .modify p
927	
928	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
929	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
930	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
931	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
932	
933	/-- Effect of `pin` (`b = true`, §74) and `unpin` (`b = false`, §75): the dynamic pinning flag of
934	the leaves of `place`. -/
935	def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) (b : Bool) : S3 :=
936	  { s with pin := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then b else s.pin l }
937	
938	/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
939	def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p true)
940	
941	/-- Preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
942	structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
943	  /-- §75: `place` is usable. -/
944	  usable : s.Usable p
945	  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
946	  right : HasRight s .modify p
947	  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone(place)`. -/
948	  externalDone : k.ExternalDone p
949	
950	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
951	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
952	    Decidable (UnpinPre k s p) :=
953	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧ k.ExternalDone p)
954	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
955	
956	/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
957	def UnpinStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
958	  Guarded (UnpinPre k s p) (pinEff s p false)
959	
960	/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/
961	
962	/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
963	inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
964	  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
965	      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
966	  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
967	      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
968	  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
969	  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
970	  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
971	  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
972	      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
973	  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
974	  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
975	  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
976	  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
977	      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
978	  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
979	  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
980	  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
981	  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
982	  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
983	      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
984	  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
985	
986	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
