1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	`WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53), `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` (§57), the declared
7	statics and `S3.init` (§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics`
8	under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
9	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
10	-/
11	
12	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
13	
14	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
15	
16	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
17	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
18	
19	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
20	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
21	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
22	
23	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
24	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
25	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
26	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
27	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
28	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
29	
30	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
31	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
32	place. -/
33	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
34	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
35	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
36	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
37	
38	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
39	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
40	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
41	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
42	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
43	
44	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
45	
46	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
47	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
48	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
49	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
50	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
51	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
52	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
53	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
54	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
55	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
56	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
57	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
58	      f < s.nF) ∧
59	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
60	      o < s.P.length) ∧
61	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
62	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
63	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
64	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
65	  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
66	  root authority. -/
67	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
68	  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
69	  rootChain : RootChain s
70	  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
71	  rootHeld : RootHeld s
72	  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
73	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
74	    HolderLive s y.holder
75	
76	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
77	
78	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
79	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
80	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
81	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
82	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
83	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
84	
85	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
86	origin's and the derived footprint is within the origin's. -/
87	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
88	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
89	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint
90	
91	/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
92	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
93	
94	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
95	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
96	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls
97	
98	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
99	def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
100	
101	/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
102	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
103	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
104	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
105	
106	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
107	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
108	
109	/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/
110	
111	/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
112	place holding `b`. -/
113	def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
114	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
115	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
116	    | .frame _ => False) False
117	
118	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
119	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
120	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
121	  | _ => True
122	
123	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
124	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
125	whole place holding the next. -/
126	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
127	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
128	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
129	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
130	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)
131	
132	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
133	
134	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
135	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
136	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
137	
138	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
139	initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
140	owning static. -/
141	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
142	
143	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
144	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
145	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
146	
147	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
148	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
149	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead or
150	pinned. -/
151	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
152	  { F := [0]
153	    nF := 1
154	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
155	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
156	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
157	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
158	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
159	    D := fun _ => []
160	    dead := fun _ => false
161	    pin := fun _ => false }
162	
163	/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
164	directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
165	def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
166	  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
167	    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False
168	
169	/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/
170	
171	/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
172	inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
173	  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
174	  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'
175	
176	/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)
177	
178	Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
179	`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/
180	
181	namespace Examples
182	
183	/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
184	external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
185	def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
186	  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩
187	
188	/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
189	instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
190	  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
191	/-- Decidability of `K0.SharedMutable` (§48). -/
192	instance : DecidablePred K0.SharedMutable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
193	/-- Decidability of `K0.Pinned` (§48). -/
194	instance : DecidablePred K0.Pinned := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
195	/-- Decidability of `K0.ExternalDone` (§48). -/
196	instance : DecidablePred K0.ExternalDone := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
197	/-- Decidability of `K0.Deallocable` (§48). -/
198	instance : DecidablePred K0.Deallocable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
199	/-- Decidability of `K0.FreeCompat` (§48). -/
200	instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (K0.FreeCompat p a) := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
201	
202	/-- Three static leaves owned by frame 0 (§47): place 0 `Init`, places 1 and 2 `Uninit`. -/
203	def st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
204	
205	/-- `S3.init st` (§47). -/
206	def s0 : S3 := S3.init st
207	/-- After `derive(0, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 3 held by frame 0. -/
208	def s1 : S3 := deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify
209	/-- After `alloc(provider 0, owner 1, one leaf)` (§71): place 3 owned by place 1, root 3. -/
210	def s2 : S3 := allocEff s0 1 [(none, 0)]
211	/-- After `derive(1, [1], Modify)` then `store(3, 0)` (§60, §65): authority 3 on leaf 1 stored in
212	place 0. -/
213	def s3 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff s0 1 [1] .modify) 3 0
214	
215	example : StaticsOK st := by decide
216	example : DerivePre s0 0 [0] .modify := by decide
217	example : SplitPre K0 s0 0 [[0]] := by decide
218	example : ReleasePre s1 3 := by decide
219	example : TransferPre K0 s0 0 1 := by decide
220	example : ¬ TransferPre K0 s0 1 0 := by decide
221	example : DependPre s1 2 3 := by decide
222	example : EnterPre s1 [3] [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
223	example : StorePre s1 3 1 := by decide
224	example : ¬ ExitPre K0 s0 := by decide
225	example : Read3Pre s0 0 [0] := by decide
226	example : Write3Pre s0 1 [1] := by decide
227	example : WriteSharedPre K0 s0 0 [0] := by decide
228	example : EndUsePre K0 s0 0 := by decide
229	example : FreePre K0 s2 3 0 := by decide
230	example : AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
231	example : ¬ AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (none, 0)] := by decide
232	example : PinPre s0 0 := by decide
233	example : UnpinPre K0 s0 0 := by decide
234	
235	/-- §63.8 decides alone: in `s3`, the transfer of place 0 to place 1 satisfies §63.1–§63.7 and is
236	rejected by local self-blocking prevention. -/
237	example : (s3.Usable 0 ∧ s3.Usable 1 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 1 ∧
238	    SameShape s3.P 0 1 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, s3.I l = .init) ∧
239	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 1, s3.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s3.P 0 1 ∧
240	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s3.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s3 0 j) ∧
241	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, ¬ K0.Pinned l ∧ s3.pin l = false) ∧
242	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s3 0, s3.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s3 0 1) ∧
243	    (∀ x ∈ List.range s3.A.length, AnchorMoves s3 0 x →
244	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s3.P.length, (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable q →
245	        OptP ((transferEff s3 0 1).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
246	          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s3 0 1) x ((transferEff s3 0 1).pframe q)) True)) ∧
247	    ¬ NoLocalSelfLock s3 0 1 ∧ ¬ TransferPre K0 s3 0 1 := by decide
248	
249	end Examples

251	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

449	/-! ## Same authorities up to holders (§42, §63) -/
450	
451	/-- Skeleton of an authority (§42): every field but its holder. -/
452	def skel (z : Authority) : Mode × Option Nat × List Nat × Bool :=
453	  (z.mode, z.origin, z.footprint, z.active)
454	
455	/-- `s'` has the authorities of `s` up to their holders (§42; §63: a transfer creates and
456	duplicates no authority). -/
457	def SameSkel (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
458	  s'.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ j : Nat, (s'.A[j]?).map skel = (s.A[j]?).map skel
459	
460	/-- An authority of `s'` has a counterpart in `s` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
461	theorem SameSkel.get {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y' : Authority}
462	    (hj : s'.A[j]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
463	  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
464	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
465	  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
466	  | some y => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y, rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩
467	
468	/-- An authority of `s` has a counterpart in `s'` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
469	theorem SameSkel.get' {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
470	    (hj : s.A[j]? = some y) : ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
471	  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
472	  cases hy : s'.A[j]? with
473	  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
474	  | some y' => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y', rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩
475	
476	/-- Same skeletons give the same origin links (§42). -/
477	theorem SameSkel.org {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.org = s.org := by
478	  funext j
479	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
480	  | none =>
481	    cases hy' : s'.A[j]? with
482	    | none => simp [S3.org, hy, hy']
483	    | some y' => obtain ⟨y, h1, -⟩ := h.get hy'; rw [hy] at h1; cases h1
484	  | some y => obtain ⟨y', hy', e⟩ := h.get' hy; simp [skel] at e; simp [S3.org, hy, hy', e.2.1]
485	
486	/-- Same skeletons give the same origin chains (§42). -/
487	theorem SameSkel.ancs {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.ancs = s.ancs := by
488	  funext j; simp [S3.ancs, h.org]
489	
490	/-- Same skeletons give the same active authorities (§42). -/
491	theorem SameSkel.active {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {x : Nat} :
492	    s'.Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
493	  constructor
494	  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩; obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h.get hy'
495	    exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [skel] at he; rw [← he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
496	  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩; obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
497	    exact ⟨y', hy', by simp [skel] at he; rw [he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
498	
499	/-- Same skeletons give the same covering descendants (§43). -/
500	theorem SameSkel.descModes {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
501	    descModes s' a p = descModes s a p := by
502	  unfold Access.descModes; rw [h.1, h.ancs]
503	  refine filterMap_congr' fun j _ => ?_
504	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
505	  | none => have := h.2 j; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[j]? <;> simp_all
506	  | some y =>
507	    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
508	    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

510	/-- Same skeletons give the same effective modes (§43). -/
511	theorem SameSkel.effective {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
512	    effective s' a p = effective s a p := by
513	  unfold Access.effective; rw [h.descModes]
514	  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
515	  | none => have := h.2 a; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[a]? <;> simp_all
516	  | some y =>
517	    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
518	    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

520	/-- `I1` depends only on the skeletons (§50). -/
521	theorem SameSkel.i1 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h1 : I1 s) : I1 s' := by
522	  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
523	  obtain ⟨x, hx, ex⟩ := h.get ha; obtain ⟨y, hy, ey⟩ := h.get hb
524	  simp [skel] at ex ey; rw [h.ancs] at hnab hnba
525	  rw [ex.1, ey.1]
526	  exact h1 a b x y p hab hx hy (ex.2.2.2 ▸ xa) (ey.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (ex.2.2.1 ▸ xp) (ey.2.2.1 ▸ yp)
527	    hnab hnba

529	/-- `I2` depends only on the skeletons (§51). -/
530	theorem SameSkel.i2 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h2 : I2 s) : I2 s' := by
531	  intro b y a hb ho
532	  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
533	  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hm, hh⟩ := h2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)
534	  obtain ⟨x', hx', e'⟩ := h.get' hx₀; simp [skel] at e'
535	  exact ⟨x', hx', by rw [e.1, e'.1]; exact hm,
536	    fun p hp => by rw [e'.2.2.1]; exact hh p (e.2.2.1 ▸ hp)⟩

538	/-- The origin clause of `WF3` depends only on the skeletons (§49.5). -/
539	theorem SameSkel.origins {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s')
540	    (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
541	    ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s'.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b := by
542	  intro b y a hb ho
543	  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
544	  exact hw b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)

546	/-- A property of every footprint member depends only on the skeletons (§49.4). -/
547	theorem SameSkel.footprints {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {Q : Nat → Prop}
548	    (hw : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l) :
549	    ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l := by
550	  intro a x hx l hl
551	  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, e⟩ := h.get hx; simp [skel] at e
552	  exact hw a x₀ hx₀ l (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl)

572	  rw [releaseEff_eq hx] at hy; simp only at hy

596	theorem WF3.ownerOf_aux {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
597	    ∀ n l r, l < n → partOf s.P l r →
598	      ∃ pl pr, s.P[l]? = some pl ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ pl.owner = pr.owner

603	    · exact ⟨pl, pl, hpl, hpl, rfl⟩
604	    cases hpo : parentOf s.P l with
605	    | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hc; simp at hc
606	    | some p =>
607	      have hpar : pl.parent = some p := by simp [parentOf, hpl] at hpo; exact hpo

613	          WF3.ownerOf_aux hw n p r (by omega) ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpr, .inr hc⟩

664	/-- Usability depends only on places, stack and death markers: a smaller stack and more dead
665	places give fewer usable places (§40). -/
666	theorem S3.Usable.mono {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : ∀ f ∈ s'.F, f ∈ s.F)

668	    s.Usable q := by
669	  induction h with
670	  | frame hpl hdq ho hf => exact .frame (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho (hF _ hf)
671	  | place hpl hdq ho _ ih => exact .place (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho ih

674	theorem S3.Usable.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
675	    {q : Nat} : s'.Usable q ↔ s.Usable q :=
676	  ⟨S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => hd ▸ h),
677	   S3.Usable.mono hP.symm (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => by rw [hd]; exact h)⟩

682	    (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : s.Usable q :=
683	  S3.Usable.mono hP (fun _ h => hF ▸ h) (fun _ h => hd ▸ h) h

773	/-- A decidable property failing somewhere below `n` has a witness below `n` (§40, search for a
774	leaf). -/
775	theorem exists_lt_not_of_not_forall {p : Nat → Prop} [DecidablePred p] :
776	    ∀ n, ¬ (∀ r < n, p r) → ∃ r < n, ¬ p r
777	  | 0, h => absurd (fun r hr => absurd hr (Nat.not_lt_zero r)) h
778	  | n + 1, h => by
779	    by_cases hn : p n
780	    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall n fun h' => h fun r hr => by
781	        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hr with hr | rfl
782	        · exact h' r hr
783	        · exact hn
784	      exact ⟨r, by omega, hp⟩

790	    ∀ n q, s.P.length - q < n → q < s.P.length → ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P q

796	      have hpr : parentOf s.P r = some q := Decidable.of_not_not hpr
797	      have hlt : ∀ i o, parentOf s.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1
798	      have hqr := hlt r q hpr
799	      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw n r (by omega) hr

802	      have hrq : q ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) r := by
803	        rw [chain_cons hpr hqr]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
804	      rcases hlr with rfl | hlr
805	      · exact hrq
806	      · exact chain_trans hlt (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) r hlr q hrq

  exact ⟨hwf.of_eq rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl, hinv.1, hinv.2.1, fun q hq x hx =>
    hinv.2.2.1 q ((S3.Usable.congr (s := s) (s' := write3Eff s ls) rfl rfl rfl).1 hq) x hx,
    i4_always _⟩

/-! ## Dynamic pinning (A8) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin p` (A8): `p` usable, exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2; `Modify` for
`pin`, B10). -/
def PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop := s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) := by unfold PinPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `pin p` / `unpin p` (A8): the leaves of `p` become pinned or unpinned. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) (b : Bool) : S3 :=
  { s with pin := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then b else s.pin l }

/-- `pin` as a relation (A8). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p true)

/-- Preconditions of `unpin p` (A8): the external use of every leaf of `p` is done
(`ExternalDone`, MM-03.3.8); B3: the right of `pin`, exercisable `Modify` on `p`. -/
def UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, k.ExternalDone l) ∧ HasRight s .modify p

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s p) := by
  unfold UnpinPre; infer_instance

/-- `unpin` as a relation (A8). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s p) (pinEff s p false)

/-- Pinning changes neither authorities nor places: `WF3` and `Inv3base` are preserved (A8). -/
theorem pinEff_preserves {s : S3} {p : Nat} {b : Bool} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) :
    WF3 (pinEff s p b) ∧ Inv3base (pinEff s p b) :=
  ⟨hwf.of_eq rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl, hinv.1, hinv.2.1, fun q hq x hx =>
    hinv.2.2.1 q ((S3.Usable.congr (s := s) (s' := pinEff s p b) rfl rfl rfl).1 hq) x hx,
    i4_always _⟩

/-! ## `endUse` (A6) -/

/-- The value at `p` ends (A6), before releasing authorities whose holder died: the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; the authorities held by `p` or one of its parts are released; the anchors
of `p` and its parts are removed; the places owned by `p` or one of its parts are logically

have hd : (freeS s p).dead r = false := by
      simp only [freeS, (hwf.deadOf hlr).symm, hl₀.dead_false, Bool.false_or,
        decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      exact hrp
    have hr₁ : (freeS s p).Usable r := S3.Usable.of_owner hpr hd (hh ▸ hlive)
    exact hl₁ ((hU l).1 (usable_of_partOf hw' (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlr ((hU r).2 hr₁)))

/-! ## Preservation by `store` (F4) -/

theorem storeEff_eq {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) :
    storeEff s a p = { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l } := by
  simp [storeEff, hy]

/-- `store` only changes the holder of `a` among the authorities (F4). -/
theorem store_skel (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : SameSkel s (storeEff s a p) := by
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => unfold storeEff; rw [hy]; exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | some y =>
    rw [storeEff_eq hy]
    refine ⟨by simp, fun j => ?_⟩
    show ((s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p })[j]?).map skel = _
    rw [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; split
    · subst_vars; simp [hy, skel]
    · rfl

theorem store_get {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (j : Nat) :
    (storeEff s a p).A[j]? = if a = j then some { y with holder := .place p } else s.A[j]? := by
  rw [storeEff_eq hy]; exact set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy)

theorem store_pre_auth {s : S3} {a : Nat}
    (h : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False) :
    ∃ y, s.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top := by
  have h1 := h; unfold OptP at h1
  split at h1
  · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, h1⟩
  · exact h1.elim

/-- `store` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (F4): it changes the holder of a derived authority to a
usable place, adds an active anchor, and writes leaves. `RootHeld` is untouched: `a` is derived. -/
theorem store_preserves {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  have hp := hpre.2.1
  have sk := store_skel s a p
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  have hn : (storeEff s a p).nF = s.nF := by rw [e]
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨⟨sk.origin hwf.origin, by rw [hP]; exact sk.fp hwf.fp, hF ▸ hwf.ne, hF ▸ hwf.nodup,
    by rw [hF, hn]; exact hwf.frames, by rw [hP, hn]; exact hwf.ownerFrame,
    by rw [hP]; exact hwf.ownerPlace, by rw [hP, hd]; exact hwf.parts, fun j z hz za => ?_,
    sk.rootChain hwf.rootChain (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP]), ?_⟩, sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2,
    fun q hq x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩
  · rw [store_get hy] at hz; split at hz
    · cases hz; exact (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 hp
    · rw [HolderLive.congr hP hF hd]; exact hwf.poss j z hz za
  · exact hwf.rootHeld.transport hP fun x z' hx ho' => by
      rw [store_get hy] at hx; split at hx
      · cases hx; exact absurd ho' ho
      · exact ⟨z', hx, ho', rfl, rfl⟩
  · have hq' := (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq
    rw [e] at hx; simp only at hx
    split at hx
    · subst q; rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact sk.active.2 (i3 _ hq' x hx)
      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact sk.active.2 ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
    · exact sk.active.2 (i3 q hq' x hx)

/-- `store` keeps the condition `EffAnchorOK` of every anchor (F4; C1): the effective anchor has
no origin (`effAnchor_root`) and `a` has one, so its holder does not change. -/
theorem store_effAnchorOK {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ho : y.origin ≠ none) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) :
    EffAnchorOK (storeEff s a p) x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have sk := store_skel s a p
  have heq : (storeEff s a p).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := effAnchor_congr (by rw [sk.ancs])
  have hne : s.effAnchor x ≠ a := fun e => by
    have := effAnchor_root hwf.origin x; rw [e] at this
    simp only [S3.org, hy, Option.bind_some] at this; exact ho this
  have hA : (storeEff s a p).A[s.effAnchor x]? = s.A[s.effAnchor x]? := by
    rw [store_get hy]; simp [Ne.symm hne]
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [heq, hA, hF]
  simp only [S3.hframe_congr hP]

/-- `store` preserves `AnchorOrder` (F4; B8, C1): the added anchor satisfies the precondition on
its effective anchor; the other anchors and frames are unchanged. -/
theorem store_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq' := (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq
  rw [store_effAnchorOK hwf hy ho, S3.pframe_congr hP]
  rw [e] at hx; simp only at hx
  split at hx
  · subst q; rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
    · exact hao _ hq' x hx
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.1
  · exact hao q hq' x hx

/-- `store` preserves `NoDangling` (F4; C2): footprints, activity and usability are unchanged. -/
theorem store_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  have sk := store_skel s a p
  exact hnd.of (fun q l hl => by rw [hP] at hl; exact hl)
    (fun q hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 hq)
    (fun j z hz za l hl => by
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, ez⟩ := sk.get hz; simp [skel] at ez
      exact ⟨j, z₀, hz₀, ez.2.2.2 ▸ za, ez.2.2.1 ▸ hl⟩)

/-- `store_root_rejected` (F4): storing an authority without origin, a root, is rejected. -/
theorem store_root_rejected {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ho : y.origin = none) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    obtain ⟨y', hy', -, ho', -⟩ := store_pre_auth h.1
    rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ho' ho

/-- `store_keeps_target_reachable` (G2): after an `ok` store, the target leaf `p` is still
exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame. -/
theorem store_keeps_target_reachable {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    HasRight s' .modify p := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1

/-- `store` writes one leaf (G2): the target `p` is a leaf, and it is the only leaf whose
initialisation changes, becoming `Init`. -/
theorem store_writes_one_leaf {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    isLeaf s.P p ∧ s'.I p = .init ∧ ∀ l, l ≠ p → s'.I l = s.I l := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  exact ⟨hpre.2.2.2.2.2.1, by simp, fun l hl => by simp [hl]⟩

/-- `store` into a leaf that holds an active authority is rejected (G2). -/
theorem store_occupied_rejected {s : S3} {a p j : Nat} {z : Authority} (hz : s.A[j]? = some z)
    (za : z.active = true) (hzp : z.holder = .place p) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    have := h.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
    simp only [OptP, hz] at this
    exact this za hzp

/-- `store` into a place with parts, such as a whole structure, is rejected (G2). -/
theorem store_nonleaf_rejected {s : S3} {a p r : Nat} (hr : r < s.P.length)
    (hpr : parentOf s.P r = some p) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => h.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr hpr

theorem mem_of_mem_dropWhile {p : Nat → Bool} : ∀ {l : List Nat} {x : Nat}, x ∈ l.dropWhile p → x ∈ l
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | b :: l, x, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons] at h
    split at h
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_of_mem_dropWhile h)
    · exact h

/-- `anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer`, the pass-6 statement of `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer`,
kept on the anchors (F4; MM-03.3.1: « Un accès temporaire ne peut être
prolongé simplement en le stockant dans un cadre plus ancien »; MM-03.3.6; C1): a value `src`,
one of whose parts (`src` included) is anchored on an authority `a` whose effective anchor does
not move with the value and is of the current frame `f`, such as an authority derived from a
local of `f` and stored into `src` or one of its fields, cannot be transferred to a destination
whose frame, after the transfer, is an older frame `g`: the dependency follows the value
(`depsOf`, MM-03.3.6; MM-03.3 §3, O4) and the clause B8 of `transfer` checks its effective
anchor. An effective anchor that moves with the value, the root of storage the value owns,
travels with it (A5). The theorem speaks of the authorities placed by `store`, which anchors
them; a block issued to `src` is held without being an anchor (pass-6 report, (d) 3). -/
theorem anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : a ∈ depsOf s src)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hin : a ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D dst := by
    simp only [transferEff, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_right _ ha
  have hok := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 dst
    (List.mem_range.2 (by have := hdst.lt; simpa [transferEff] using this)) hdst a hin (.inr (.inl rfl))
  rw [transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  rw [hF] at hok
  unfold ancestor at hok
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ hgF)
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte] at hok
  exact hnd.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile hok)

/-- `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` (F4, restated on the holder by G4; MM-03.3.1: « Un accès
temporaire ne peut être prolongé simplement en le stockant dans un cadre plus ancien »; C1): a
value `src`, one of whose parts (`src` included) holds an active authority `a` whose effective
anchor does not move with the value and is of the current frame `f`, cannot be transferred to a
destination whose frame, after the transfer, is an older frame `g`: the authority follows the
value (A4) and G4 checks its effective anchor in the arrival state. No restriction to `store`:
the authority may have been placed by `store`, `issue` or an earlier `transfer`. -/
theorem store_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {y z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ya : y.active = true) (hh : heldIn s.P src y.holder)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨r', e, hr'⟩ := mvTo_part hwf hpre.2.2.1.lt hh
  have ha' : (transferEff s src dst).A[a]? = some { y with holder := .place r' } := by
    rw [transfer_A_get, ha]; simp [hh, e]
  have hok := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r' (transfer_usable_part hwf hr' hdst) a _ ha' ya rfl
  rw [transfer_pframe_part hwf hr', transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  rw [hF] at hok
  unfold ancestor at hok
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ hgF)
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte] at hok
  exact hnd.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile hok)

/-! ## Absence of orphan authorities (G3) -/

/-- G3, one link of a chain of holders: `a` is an active authority that covers the place holding
`b`, every leaf of that place being in the footprint of `a`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-! ## Preservation of `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1) -/

theorem effAnchor_mem (s : S3) (x : Nat) : s.effAnchor x = x ∨ s.effAnchor x ∈ s.ancs x :=
  List.mem_cons.1 (List.getLastD_mem_cons (l := s.ancs x) (a := x))

theorem effAnchor_le (s : S3) (x : Nat) : s.effAnchor x ≤ x := by
  rcases effAnchor_mem s x with h | h
  · exact Nat.le_of_eq h
  · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt h)

/-- The effective anchor of `x` is the element without origin of its chain (C1). -/
theorem effAnchor_eq {s : S3} : ∀ n x, x < n → ∀ r, (r = x ∨ r ∈ s.ancs x) → s.org r = none →
    s.effAnchor x = r
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx, r, hr, hro => by
    rcases hr with rfl | hr
    · simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none hro]
    · cases ho : s.org x with
      | none => rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at hr; simp at hr
      | some o =>
        rcases ancs_step ho with ⟨hlt, he⟩ | he
        · have e : s.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor o := by
            simp only [S3.effAnchor, he, List.getLastD_cons]
          rw [e]; rw [he] at hr
          exact effAnchor_eq n o (by omega) r (List.mem_cons.1 hr) hro
        · rw [he] at hr; simp at hr

/-- Under the order of origins of `WF3`, the effective anchor has no origin (C1, B1). -/
theorem effAnchor_root {s : S3} (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y →
    y.origin = some a → a < b) (x : Nat) : s.org (s.effAnchor x) = none := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hro⟩ := reanchor_reaches_root hw (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x)
  rw [effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) r hr hro]; exact hro

theorem effAnchor_congr {s s' : S3} {x : Nat} (h : s'.ancs x = s.ancs x) :
    s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, h]

theorem EffAnchorOK.get {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) :
    ∃ z, s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK at h
  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
  | none => rw [hz] at h; exact h.elim
  | some z => exact ⟨z, rfl⟩

/-- The effective anchor of an `EffAnchorOK` anchor has a frame. -/
theorem EffAnchorOK.frame {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} {z : Authority}
    (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) :
    ∃ g, s.hframe z.holder = some g := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK at h; rw [hz] at h; simp only [OptP] at h
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => rw [hg] at h; exact h.elim
  | some g => exact ⟨g, rfl⟩

/-- An `EffAnchorOK` anchor is an authority of `A`. -/
theorem EffAnchorOK.lt {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) :
    x < s.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h.get
  rcases effAnchor_mem s x with e | e
  · rw [e] at hz; exact lt_of_getElem? hz
  · have : s.org x ≠ none := fun ho => by rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at e; simp at e
    simp only [S3.org] at this
    cases hx : s.A[x]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at this; exact absurd rfl this
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hx

theorem effAnchorOK_of_same {s s' : S3} {x x' : Nat} {z z' : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hz' : s'.A[s'.effAnchor x']? = some z')
    (hh : s'.hframe z'.holder = s.hframe z.holder) {fd fd' : Option Nat}
    (hanc : ∀ g f, fd = some f → (ancestor s'.F g f ↔ ancestor s.F g f)) (hfd : fd' = fd) :
    EffAnchorOK s' x' fd' ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  rw [hfd]; unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [hz, hz']; simp only [OptP]; rw [hh]
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => simp
  | some g =>
    cases hf : fd with
    | none => simp
    | some f => simp only; rw [hanc g f hf]

theorem effAnchorOK_congr {s s' : S3} (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have ho : s'.org = s.org := funext fun i => by simp only [S3.org, hA]
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by unfold S3.effAnchor S3.ancs; rw [ho]
  simp only [EffAnchorOK, he, hA, hF, S3.hframe_congr hP]

/-- `AnchorOrder` carries over to a state with the same places and stack, fewer usable places,
fewer anchors, the same chains of origins, and the same holders for the existing authorities
(B8, C1). -/
theorem AnchorOrder.of {s s' : S3} (ho : AnchorOrder s) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hu : ∀ q, s'.Usable q → s.Usable q) (hD : ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, x ∈ s.D q)
    (hanc : ∀ a, a < s.A.length → s'.ancs a = s.ancs a)
    (hA : ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y →
      ∃ y', s'.A[x]? = some y' ∧ y'.origin = y.origin ∧ y'.holder = y.holder) :
    AnchorOrder s' := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hok := ho q (hu q hq) x (hD q hq x hx)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := effAnchor_congr (hanc x hok.lt)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e2⟩ := hA _ z hz
  exact (effAnchorOK_of_same hz (by rw [he]; exact hz') (by rw [e2, S3.hframe_congr hP])
    (fun g f _ => by rw [hF]) (S3.pframe_congr hP q)).2 hok

stack, and the first is the second or one of its ancestors (B8, C1). -/

theorem depend_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, hok⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro r hr y hy
  have hr' : s.Usable r := hr.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl
  rw [effAnchorOK_congr (s' := dependEff s q x) (s := s) rfl rfl rfl,
    S3.pframe_congr (s' := dependEff s q x) (s := s) rfl]
  simp only [dependEff] at hy
  split at hy
  · rename_i hrq; subst hrq
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hy with hy | hy
    · exact hao _ hr' y hy
    · simp at hy; subst hy; exact hok
  · exact hao r hr' y hy

/-- `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin` and `unpin` preserve `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1): they change neither
places, stack, anchors nor authorities. -/
theorem write3_preserves_anchorOrder {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (hao : AnchorOrder s) :
    AnchorOrder (write3Eff s ls) :=
  hao.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ _ _ hx => hx) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ y hy => ⟨y, hy, rfl, rfl⟩)

/-- Under the order of origins of `WF3`, the walk along origins from `x` (A7) reaches a root:
some authority among `x` and its ancestors has no origin. Without that order, `chain` stops at
the first link that does not decrease. -/
theorem reanchor_reaches_root {s : S3} (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat),
    s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
    ∀ n x, x < n → ∃ r, (r = x ∨ r ∈ s.ancs x) ∧ s.org r = none
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
    cases ho : s.org x with
    | none => exact ⟨x, .inl rfl, ho⟩
    | some o =>
      have hlt := org_lt hw ho
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hro⟩ := reanchor_reaches_root hw n o (by omega)
      refine ⟨r, .inr ?_, hro⟩
      rw [ancs_cons hw ho]
      rcases hr with rfl | hr
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr

/-- One step of a chain of origins: the chain from `x` starts with the origin of `x`, which is
smaller, or it is empty. -/
theorem ancs_step {s : S3} {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) :
    (o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o) ∨ s.ancs x = [] := by
  by_cases hlt : o < x
  · exact .inl ⟨hlt, chain_cons h hlt⟩
  · right; unfold S3.ancs chain
    cases x with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp [chainF, h, hlt]

theorem S3.Usable.dead_false {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : s.dead q = false := by
  cases h <;> assumption

/-- A place that exists, is not dead and has a live owner is usable (A5). -/
theorem S3.Usable.of_owner {s : S3} {q : Nat} {pl : Place} (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl)
    (hd : s.dead q = false) (h : HolderLive s pl.owner) : s.Usable q := by
  cases ho : pl.owner with
  | frame f => rw [ho] at h; exact .frame hpl hd ho h
  | place o => rw [ho] at h; exact .place hpl hd ho h

/-- A place with a usable part is usable (A5, `WF3`). -/
theorem usable_of_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P l r) (hu : s.Usable l) :
    s.Usable r := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pr, hpl, hpr, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf h
  exact hu.of_same hpl hpr ho.symm (hw.deadOf h).symm

/-- `NoDangling` carries over when no footprint grows, no usable place stops being usable, and
every active authority covers only leaves of an active authority of the previous state (C2). -/
theorem NoDangling.of {s s' : S3} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (hfp : ∀ q l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q → l ∈ footprint s.P q)
    (hu : ∀ q, s.Usable q → s'.Usable q)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some z → z.active = true → ∀ l ∈ z.footprint,
      ∃ (i : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[i]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ l ∈ y.footprint) :
    NoDangling s' := by
  intro j z hz za q hq l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨i, y, hy, ya, hly⟩ := hA j z hz za l hlz
  exact hnd i y hy ya q (fun h => hq (hu q h)) l (hfp q l hl) hly

/-- `derive` preserves `NoDangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §3, O1): the derived footprint is within the
footprint of the active origin. -/
theorem derive_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
theorem depend_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hnd.of (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ h => h.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl)
    fun j z hz za _ hl => ⟨j, z, hz, za, hl⟩

/-- `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin` and `unpin` preserve `NoDangling` (C2): they change neither
places, stack, `dead` flags nor authorities. -/
theorem write3_preserves_noDangling {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (hnd : NoDangling s) :
    NoDangling (write3Eff s ls) :=
  hnd.of (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ h => h.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl)
    fun j z hz za _ hl => ⟨j, z, hz, za, hl⟩

/-- `pin` and `unpin` preserve `NoDangling` (C2; A8): they only set the pin state. -/
theorem pinEff_preserves_noDangling {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (hnd : NoDangling s) :
    NoDangling (pinEff s p b) :=
  hnd.of (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ h => h.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl)
    fun j z hz za _ hl => ⟨j, z, hz, za, hl⟩

/-- `transfer` preserves `NoDangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §3, O4): footprints are unchanged, every usable
place stays usable, and authorities only change holder. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_noDangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
/-! ## Preservation of `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4) -/

theorem ancestor_self {f : Nat} : ∀ {F : Frames}, f ∈ F → ancestor F f f
  | g :: F, h => by
    unfold ancestor
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    by_cases e : g = f
    · subst e; simp
    · have hgf : (g != f) = true := by simp [e]
      simp only [hgf, ↓reduceIte]
      exact ancestor_self (List.mem_cons.1 h |>.resolve_left (fun h' => e h'.symm))

/-- A root authority held by a usable place satisfies the condition of G4: it is its own effective
anchor, of the frame of its holder (C1). -/
theorem effAnchorOK_root_held {s : S3} {x q : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y)
    (ho : y.origin = none) (hh : y.holder = .place q) (hq : s.Usable q) :
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) := by
  have he : s.effAnchor x = x :=
    effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) x (.inl rfl) (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho])
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
  have hpf : s.pframe q = some f := pframe_iff.2 hf
  unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [he, hy]
  simp only [OptP, hh, S3.hframe, hpf]
  exact ancestor_self hfF

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over to a state with the same places and stack, fewer usable places,
the same chains of origins and holders for the existing authorities, and no new active authority
held by a place (G4). -/
theorem AnchorOrderHeld.of {s s' : S3} (ho : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hu : ∀ q, s'.Usable q → s.Usable q)
    (hanc : ∀ a, a < s.A.length → s'.ancs a = s.ancs a)
    (hA : ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y →
      ∃ y', s'.A[x]? = some y' ∧ y'.origin = y.origin ∧ y'.holder = y.holder)
    (hback : ∀ (x q : Nat) (y' : Authority), s'.A[x]? = some y' → y'.active = true →
      y'.holder = .place q → ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .place q) :
    AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  intro q hq x y' hx ya hh
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya₀, hh₀⟩ := hback x q y' hx ya hh
  have hok := ho q (hu q hq) x y hy ya₀ hh₀
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := effAnchor_congr (hanc x hok.lt)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e2⟩ := hA _ z hz
  exact (effAnchorOK_of_same hz (by rw [he]; exact hz') (by rw [e2, S3.hframe_congr hP])
    (fun g f _ => by rw [hF]) (S3.pframe_congr hP q)).2 hok

/-- An active authority held by a place after releases was active and held by it before. -/
theorem OnlyReleases.back {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) {x q : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hx : s₁.A[x]? = some y') (ya : y'.active = true) (hh : y'.holder = .place q) :
    ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .place q := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, -, e, ha⟩ := h.2 x y' hx
  exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya, e ▸ hh⟩

/-- `derive` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O1): the new authority is held by the
frame; the others keep holders and chains. -/
theorem derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode}
    (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hs : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  refine h.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ ha => ancs_addAuth_lt ha)
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by rw [deriveEff, addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun x q y' hx ya hh => ?_
  rcases addAuth_get hx with ⟨-, hx'⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨y', hx', ya, hh⟩
  · cases hh

/-- `split` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O2): the new authorities are held by the
frame. -/
theorem split_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hs : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  refine h.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl)
    (fun a ha => chain_congr fun j hj => by
      simp only [S3.org]; show ((s.A ++ _)[j]?).bind _ = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)])
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by
      show (s.A ++ _)[x]? = _; rw [List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy,
      rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun x q y' hx ya hh => ?_
  have hx' : (s.A ++ rs.map fun r => (⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ : Authority))[x]? =
    some y' := hx
  by_cases hxl : x < s.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hxl] at hx'; exact ⟨y', hx', ya, hh⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_map] at hx'
    cases hr : rs[x - s.A.length]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at hx'; cases hx'
    | some r => rw [hr] at hx'; cases hx'; cases hh

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over when authorities are only released and places, stack and
usability do not grow (G4). -/
theorem releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld {s s₁ : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁) (hP : s₁.P = s.P) (hF : s₁.F = s.F)
    (hu : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → s.Usable q) : AnchorOrderHeld s₁ :=
  h.of hP hF hu (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs; rw [hr.org]) (fun _ _ hy => hr.fwd hy)
    fun _ _ _ hx ya hh => hr.back hx ya hh

/-- `release` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
theorem release_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hs : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  exact releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld h (release_releases s a) hP hF
    fun _ hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over when authorities, places, stack and `dead` flags are unchanged
(G4): `depend`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`, `newArena`, `reset`. -/
theorem sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hA : s'.A = s.A)
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : AnchorOrderHeld s' :=
  h.of hP hF (fun _ hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq)
    (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs S3.org; rw [hA]) (fun _ y hy => ⟨y, by rw [hA]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun _ _ y' hx ya hh => ⟨y', by rw [← hA]; exact hx, ya, hh⟩

/-- `endUse` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; A6). -/
theorem endUse_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hs : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  exact releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld h ((endUseS_releases s p).trans cleanup_releases) rfl rfl
    fun q hq => S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseEff s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
      (fun q h => by simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hq

x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe :=
  h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hnab hnba

/-- Central theorem (MM-03.3 §5): in a state satisfying `Inv3base`, an authorised ordinary write
coexists with no other authority with a present effective mode on the written leaves. The proof
uses only the effective `Modify` of the writer. -/
theorem write3_exclusive {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')) : ∀ p ∈ ls, ∀ b, b ≠ a → effective s b p = none := by
  intro p hp b hb
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hw⟩, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact effective_exclusive hinv.1 (Ne.symm hb) (hw p hp).1

/-! ## Reused lemmas on chains, additions and skeletons -/

theorem nil_of_forall_not_mem {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a, a ∉ l) → l = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: _, h => absurd (List.mem_cons_self ..) (h a)

theorem pairwise_lt_range : ∀ n, (List.range n).Pairwise (· < ·)
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
  cases he : effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p with
  | none => trivial
  | some e => exact effective_compat hI b _ p e m (by have := List.mem_range.1 hb; omega) he hn

/-- The removed clause of `canWrite3` follows from its first clause under I1 (MM-03.3 §5;
A11). -/
theorem canWrite3_excl_redundant {s : S3} (h1 : I1 s) {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (hw : canWrite3 s a ls) : ∀ p ∈ ls, ∀ b, b ≠ a → effective s b p = none :=
  fun p hp _ hb => effective_exclusive h1 (Ne.symm hb) (hw.2 p hp).1

/-! ## Arena (MM-03.3 §6, A10) -/

/-- The place of the arena value: the holder of `internal` (F1, replacing the owner of the storage
of A10 and D3). -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[ar.internal]? with
  | some y =>
    match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none
    TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') ↔ TransferPre k s src dst ∧ s' = transferEff s src dst := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
theorem depend_det {q x : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : DependStep q x s o₁) (h₂ : DependStep q x s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
theorem depend_ok_iff {q x : Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    DependStep q x s (.ok s') ↔ DependPre s q x ∧ s' = dependEff s q x := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `enter` (MM-03.3 §4, O6). -/
theorem enter_det {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : EnterStep ps ls s o₁) (h₂ : EnterStep ps ls s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `enter` (MM-03.3 §4, O6). -/
theorem enter_ok_iff {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {s s' : S3} :
    EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') ↔ EnterPre s ps ls ∧ s' = enterEff s ps ls := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `exit` (MM-03.3 §4, O7). -/
theorem exit_det {k : K}  {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : ExitStep k s o₁) (h₂ : ExitStep k s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `exit` (MM-03.3 §4, O7). -/
theorem exit_ok_iff {k : K}  {s s' : S3} :
    ExitStep k s (.ok s') ↔ ExitPre k s ∧ s' = exitEff s := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `read3` (MM-03.3 §5). -/
theorem read3_det {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : Read3Step a ls s o₁) (h₂ : Read3Step a ls s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `read3` (MM-03.3 §5). -/
theorem read3_ok_iff {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') ↔ canRead3 s a ls ∧ s' = s := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `write3` (MM-03.3 §5). -/
theorem write3_det {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : Write3Step a ls s o₁) (h₂ : Write3Step a ls s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `write3` (MM-03.3 §5). -/
theorem write3_ok_iff {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') ↔ canWrite3 s a ls ∧ s' = write3Eff s ls := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `writeShared` (A9). -/
theorem writeShared_det {k : K} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : WriteSharedStep k a ls s o₁) (h₂ : WriteSharedStep k a ls s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `writeShared` (A9). -/
theorem writeShared_ok_iff {k : K} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') ↔ WriteSharedPre k s a ls ∧ s' = write3Eff s ls := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `pin` (A8). -/
theorem pin_det {p : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : PinStep p s o₁) (h₂ : PinStep p s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `pin` (A8). -/
theorem pin_ok_iff {p : Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    PinStep p s (.ok s') ↔ PinPre s p ∧ s' = pinEff s p true := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `unpin` (A8). -/
theorem unpin_det {k : K} {p : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : UnpinStep k p s o₁) (h₂ : UnpinStep k p s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `ok` outcome of `unpin` (A8). -/
theorem unpin_ok_iff {k : K} {p : Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') ↔ UnpinPre k s p ∧ s' = pinEff s p false := Guarded.ok_iff

/-- Determinism of `endUse` (A6). -/
theorem endUse_det {k : K} {p : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : EndUseStep k p s o₁) (h₂ : EndUseStep k p s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂
